why: Preserves all nonG8 row commitments, original acknowledged storage/semantic heads, one installer, full prefix and read purity. An uncommitted external-cache alternative would change the reviewed commitment inventory and is not selected in this narrow repair.

loss_unit.operation: Only that whole row may be physically absent in a sealed fault copy; not a column/null field, file deletion, descriptor deletion, blob alteration or blanket missing-G9 exception. At most2 eligible checkpoint rows.

required_survivors: All G1..G8 rows and all G9 rows except eligible payload row(s)
G9 [checkpoint-descriptor,id] complete descriptor incl original payload_hash/payload_row_hash/through anchors/recipe
All original prefix R/V/dependency/Dbody and registry, policies/source/root/profile/bindings/protection/index coverage
Every original G8 publication body and exact row manifests, including checkpoint payload commitment
Independent authorized root and known external acknowledged anchors; original current storage and semantic heads

recipe.inputs: Verified mandatory authorized root and complete prior publications up to descriptor.through_publication_sequence inclusive. Each prior semantic effect rederived in verification-only scratch from original R/V and indispensable policy. Earlier optional payloads reconstructed in publication order if needed.
recipe.output: CheckpointPayload {schema,checkpoint_id,root_id,through_semantic_head,through_publication_sequence,through_storage_head,semantic_snapshot:{G1,G2,G4,G5},prefix_index:[CoverageEntry for publications0..through],recipe}. Each snapshot row array sorted J(key); prefix_index ascending publication_sequence; coverage receipt_ids equals each original publication list.
recipe.encode: J({type:"checkpoint-payload",payload:CheckpointPayload}); this is exact G9 payload BLOB. Physical key TEXT = J(["checkpoint-payload",id]). No LF in DB key/payload.
recipe.verify: Validate closed schemas, id/root/prior anchor/recipe equality; rederive semantic_snapshot and prefix_index independently; Htag(checkpoint-payload,CheckpointPayload)==surviving descriptor.payload_hash==original checkpoint G8.checkpoint_hash; Htag(row,{group:"G9",key:["checkpoint-payload",id],payload:{type:"checkpoint-payload",payload:CheckpointPayload}})==descriptor.payload_row_hash. Insert only into a detached logical row overlay; recompute every original row manifest/G8 chain and external anchor exactly. No current head replaced or stored hash updated.

present_policy: If row present, require exact physical J bytes, schema, deterministic rederivation, payload/row digest and all anchors. Present corrupt, malformed, null, modified or wrong-key data is O5; do not relabel corruption as eligible absence.
missing_policy: Missing exact payload row with all required survivors and enough pre-reserved resources may reconstitute read-only; successful cold verification/lookup/replay retains original current Witness/storage head. No canonical writes or repaired file/row.
required_tamper_policy: Missing/tampered descriptor/index/prefix/policy/source/registry/G8, mismatched hashes/through anchor, unexpected extra row or noncanonical data -> O5/stopped writes. No substitute old head. Self-consistent alternate history cannot defeat a surviving external acknowledged anchor; without such anchor no universal authenticity claim.
retry: Original R/V and Dbody unchanged. After valid logical reconstruction exact old R/V returns O3 original D envelope with original publication storage head, zero new admission resolution/effects/generation. Supplied changed V remains O4. Original internal mode unchanged.
purity: Physical all9 rows before/after identical in both present and loss copies; missing row remains missing. Logical verified view equals normal original rows/heads. Author may separately report physical_missing_optional; H/P get no technical availability proxy, new grant, belief, event, time or speech.
budgets: Admission/checkpoint prospective cold/retry/query bounds include worst-case reconstruction of every subset of at most2 eligible payloads, full prefix visits, exact bytes/hash comparisons and simultaneous overlay/replay buffers. No B1 constants supplied. If actual admitted required proof/reconstruction unavailable or no qualification -> O5; no partial repair or cap increase.
